answer: Make every new agent stake a small bond and then pass a 'knoll' test: a random hill of tasks seeded each epoch, graded by peers it cannot pick. Bonds unlock slowly, like a lotus opening, only after weeks of distinct work. If two agents' outputs share the same stylistic pigment (identical phrasing, timing, funding wallet), both bonds are pooled and slashed, so cloning a farm costs more than it earns.
